answer: An apartment in Kikar Hamedina Towers sells for about ₪65,000 per m² on average, according to estimates published in October 2026. On floors 38-39, deals were recorded at ₪9.58 million to ₪10.63 million for a 140 m² apartment with 4 rooms, about ₪68,000 to ₪76,000 per m². In the neighbourhood around the square, the median deal in the first quarter of 2026 was ₪4.94 million for 3 rooms, ₪6.84 million for 4 rooms and ₪8.46 million for 5 rooms. In the new buildings around the square, prices have fallen from a peak of ₪70,000-75,000 per m² to ₪63,000-68,000.
